title: GameEngineBench: Full-Session Verification of Coding Agents in a Networked Game Engine
abstract: arXiv:2607.03525v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Coding agents face new challenges in game development, where they must produce code that is not only syntactically correct but also consistent with engine-managed lifecycle, state, and networking behavior. Existing game-development benchmarks, however, do not combine assertions over engine-based runtime states with cross-client consistency, failing to evaluate how well generated code adheres to the desired behavioral specifications. To address these limitations, we present GameEngineBench, a benchmark of 110 C++ implementation tasks derived from 9 existing Unreal Engine 5 projects. Each task requires an agent to implement missing behavior within an established gameplay architecture. We also introduce Full-Session Verification, a testing framework that injects hidden tests after the agent finishes and evaluates the resulting implementation inside Play-in-Editor (PIE) sessions, with networked client worlds in 71 tasks. translated_title: GameEngineBench：在网络化游戏引擎中对编码智能体进行全程会话验证
translated_abstract: 编码智能体在游戏开发中面临新的挑战，它们必须生成不仅语法正确，而且与引擎管理的生命周期、状态和网络行为保持一致的代码。然而，现有的游戏开发基准测试未能将针对引擎运行时状态的断言与跨客户端一致性相结合，因而无法评估生成的代码在多大程度上符合预期的行为规范。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了 GameEngineBench，这是一个包含 110 个 C++ 实现任务的基准测试，这些任务源自 9 个现有的虚幻引擎 5（Unreal Engine 5）项目。每个任务要求智能体在既定的游戏玩法架构中实现缺失的行为。我们还引入了全程会话验证，这是一个测试框架，它在智能体完成任务后注入隐藏测试，并在编辑器内运行会话中评估最终实现，其中 71 个任务包含联网的客户端世界。测试……
tldr: 该论文提出了 GameEngineBench 基准（包含源自虚幻引擎 5 项目的 110 个 C++ 实现任务），并引入全程会话验证框架，通过在 PIE 会话（含联网客户端世界）中注入隐藏测试，来评估编码智能体所生成代码的行为正确性与跨客户端一致性。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces GameEngineBench, a benchmark of 110 C++ implementation tasks derived from Unreal Engine 5 projects, together with Full-Session Verification, a framework that injects hidden tests into Play-in-Editor sessions (including networked client worlds) to evaluate coding agents' code for behavioral correctness and cross-client consistency.
